mapper.select: SELECT ingest_id,source_id,contact_type,fingerprint,fingerprint_key_id,is_authorized AS authorized, contact_ciphertext,contact_nonce,contact_tag,contact_key_id,contact_algorithm,authorization_basis, authorized_at,expires_at FROM t_authorized_contact_vault WHERE ingest_id=#{ingestId} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_authorized_contact_vault( ingest_id,source_id,contact_type,fingerprint,fingerprint_key_id,is_authorized,contact_ciphertext, contact_nonce,contact_tag,contact_key_id,contact_algorithm,authorization_basis,authorized_at,expires_at ) VALUES( #{ingestId},#{sourceId},#{contactType},#{fingerprint},#{fingerprintKeyId},#{authorized},#{contactCiphertext}, #{contactNonce},#{contactTag},#{contactKeyId},#{contactAlgorithm},#{authorizationBasis},#{authorizedAt}, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 90 DAY) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_id=COALESCE(VALUES(source_id),source_id),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_authorized_contact_vault SET source_id=#{sourceId} WHERE ingest_id=#{ingestId}
